competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (strand ng community mobilization): kasama ang komunidad, natutukoy ng BHW ang isyu batay sa iniulat na ebidensiya at pananaw ng apektado, nag-iimbita nang may pagtugon sa hadlang sa pakikilahok, nangangasiwa ng maikling pulong na may kusang pinagkasunduang tungkulin ng pangunahing grupo, at bumubuo ng action plan na may responsable, kumpirmadong resources, petsa, follow-up at panukat na sinusuri kasama ang residente.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (community mobilization strand): working with the community, the BHW frames an issue from reported evidence and affected residents' perspectives, invites people while addressing barriers to participation, facilitates a short meeting that agrees voluntary core-group roles, and builds an action plan with an owner, confirmed resources, dates, follow-up and a measure reviewed with residents.
